elements.name: loft-13 Place an intermediate section on a center-line loft

steps.name: a disposable copy of the native fixture "fixtures/cad/loft/circles-center-line-20.opd" is open
the user creates Loft1 from the two circular profiles and the 20 mm center line
Loft1 is reopened for editing with its two sections and center line selected
the user selects placed-sections mode and clicks the center line near its midpoint
a Point1 entry and the Section Dimensions dialog appear
the preview shows an intermediate section with position and area annotations
the user accepts the section dimensions and the Loft dialog
Loft1 remains in the browser and a solid is visible
